title: Docker Supabase environment
description: Create docker/docker-compose.yml with full Supabase services stack (PostgreSQL, GoTrue, PostgREST, Realtime, Kong, Studio). Set up MinIO for local S3-compatible storage. Create .env.example with all required variables. Include kong.yml for API gateway configuration.

title: Offline sync engine
description:
Create full sync engine in apps/mobile/services/sync/:
- engine.ts: Main sync coordinator
- queue.ts: Mutation queue with exponential backoff

Features:
- Local SQLite as source of truth for reads
- Mutation queue for pending writes (stored in SQLite)
- Background sync when online (use @react-native-community/netinfo)
- Conflict resolution: timestamp-based last-write-wins
- Sync status tracking per record ('pending', 'synced', 'conflict')
- Pull changes from Supabase on app foreground
- Push local mutations when connectivity available

Create useSync hook for components to trigger sync operations.

- Serving size selector (from API servingSizeUnit)
- Quantity/servings input

title: Food entry form
description:

Integrate with calculation engine for real-time recalculation.

title: Calculation engine
description:
Create packages/shared/utils/calculations.ts with:

BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor):
- Males: (10 × weight[kg]) + (6.25 × height[cm]) – (5 × age) + 5
- Females: (10 × weight[kg]) + (6.25 × height[cm]) – (5 × age) – 161

TDEE = BMR × activity_multiplier

Macro splits by goal:
- Lose: 40% protein, 30% carbs, 30% fat
- Maintain: 30% protein, 40% carbs, 30% fat
- Gain: 30% protein, 45% carbs, 25% fat

Unit conversions (lbs↔kg, inches↔cm).

title: Food database service
description:
Create apps/mobile/services/food-search.ts for USDA FoodData Central API:
- Search endpoint: https://api.nal.usda.gov/fdc/v1/foods/search
- Details endpoint: https://api.nal.usda.gov/fdc/v1/food/{fdcId}
- Parse response to extract: fdcId, description, brandName, servingSize, nutrients (calories, protein, carbs, fat)

Interface:
- searchFoods(query: string): Promise<FoodSearchResult[]>
- getFoodDetails(fdcId: string): Promise<FoodDetails>

Cache recent searches in SQLite for offline access.
